description: Shared object definitions used by lessdugin records (data-model.md §4).

media.description: A media attachment (image, video, audio or PDF). Downloads are saved as <cid>.<ext-from-sniffed-type>.

blob.description: The blob object returned by uploadBlob, embedded verbatim.

alt.description: Accessible description. Writers warn when it is missing.

aspectRatio.description: Layout hint; display clamps it to between 1:20 and 20:1.

name.description: Opt-in, display-only basename. Readers ignore a name containing '/', '\', a C0 or C1 control, U+2028 or U+2029.

textQuote.description: Selects text in the plain-text projection P (lfm-1.md) of the target's body. Resolution is deterministic and defined in lfm-1.md.

exact.description: The quoted text, trimmed so it starts and ends on a non-space.

prefix.description: Verbatim text of P immediately before exact. Writers SHOULD use at most 32 graphemes.

suffix.description: Verbatim text of P immediately after exact. Writers SHOULD use at most 32 graphemes.

start.description: Code-point offset of exact in P of the version the writer saw. Hint only.

externalLink.description: A link card. Writers fill title, description and thumb manually or by a native fetch; the SPA never fetches cards.

uri.description: Target URL. Shown as a link only if safe_href accepts it; otherwise shown as text.

link.description: A labelled URL, shown through safe_href.
